page.layout: One page fragment: at the right edge of the strip, a column of large bold Roman numerals set down the page, each partly cut at the right. No other text is visible; the binding gutter runs along the left.; One column of Scripture references under topic headings, with margin numerals at the left. Top: running head and page number. Above the first heading: continuation lines of references, in italic. Below: topic headings with their page numbers and reference lines, then a final heading and its lines at the foot.
page.notes: Bold black Roman numerals, set one per line down the right edge of this strip, the right side of each cut away. Whether they are line numbers, section numbers or marginal figures cannot be told from this part. The binding gutter, with dark shadow lines, lies along the left edge and is not printed text. The page number is printed in old form, "8z", read here as 82. The sign after "C.25" is a small glyph that may be "&" or "ꝗ"; I read it as "&[?]". The margin numerals are copied from the left margin beside each heading. The heading numbers 29 to 34 are printed in old form (for example "2ç" for 29), copied as their Arabic values. Line "C.5. V.12." may have "C.5" printed as "C.5"; checked as read.
